eventDetail.scope: GTSS 2027 will explore the core aspects of sustainability, green engineering, renewable energy, and eco-friendly systems that align with the evolving dynamics of nature and human societies. The conference will focus on the development of intelligent and adaptive green technologies that enhance efficiency, minimize environmental impact, and provide long-term solutions for climate change mitigation and resource management.
